scope: Initial public snapshot and later v0.2.x utility; this is a feature inventory, not a claim that every source line or commit is certified.

features.remaining: Wind correction integrated. Water 30 Hz model and native callable-original adapter pass model mutation/sanitizer and retail-entry ABI tests; physical performance passed; a separate copied-save lake test verifies live activity, grid restoration, short movement and inspected captures. Controlled temporal equivalence and actual impulse preservation remain pending; default off. Native adapter uses game-time bank, not the upstream shared 30 Hz effect schedule. The schedule helper is ported and tested but not wired to native effect updates. Smooth effects, class/emission/ribbon rules, all count handovers and VRR remain under comparison. Bloodletter correction is opt-in only. Three natural transformed-L2 aura activations each pass at stock30, native60, and native60 with the experimental clock, all at original 0.4 m. Automatic enlargement has no demonstrated need in these controls. Earlier enabled-correction loaded-field performance and custom 0.8 m preservation evidence remain build-specific.
Long-session audio, attack events and physical device quality pending.
Online recording/playback and full session acceptance pending.
Runtime keyboard/controller, storage and wheel interaction coverage remains to complete.

Guest barrier assist and ordered draw assistance implemented; architecture-specific draw bypass and area-specific benefit still require comparison. Latest BBHOST 6d2b7ea itself keeps constant-buffer homes/segment workers off at <=60 FPS because their threads cost CPU without improving a capped rate; do not add those workers to this 60-FPS profile without local evidence.

Deferred image materialization and source redirection are not implemented. Ordered actual-transfer capture and profiler labels added for measurement. Full write/read/retire coverage, texture memo invalidation, backing ownership and GPU-content equivalence remain prerequisites. BBHost itself defaults this off on discrete GPUs.
16 MiB retirement has active GPU read tests and an accepted 15-cycle native wind-build soak; later build acceptance and broader areas remain separate.
Broader face/preset combinations, regions and long sessions remain separate; default off and user map mods keep priority.

features.remaining: Full offline native UI and restart persistence are verified: Spanish labels, no-stone refusal, native level purchase, menu return, exact undo, accept, map transition and separate-process reload. Actual setup produces the feature layer with selected user mods; launcher/CLI controls and normal helper build are wired. Default remains off. The current default-off build also passes a physical 600-second native capture. Broader feature qualification and final release remain separate.

Generated TOML mods and read-only live repository are verified. Shared native metadata traversal batches bounded reads, preserving duplicate/unsorted ID semantics. Native ordered row-ID enumeration (count-only/prefix/full) matches the loaded retail tables in a copied-save physical capture. A narrowly guarded Bloodletter radius writer exists; general named-field live overrides and the public plugin service table remain pending.

features.remaining: A truthful 12-service version-1 prefix now passes real DSO, native import fallback, lifetime, publication and API-drain tests, plus ASan/UBSan and targeted TSan. A guarded actual-game pre-bind/pre-entry adapter passed a physical 120-second FSR4.1 native capture on copied saves, with checked image-phase and process-context data write/read/restore. Normal-launch discovery/configuration/ELF/VMA wiring and all services beyond that prefix remain pending; no complete API16 compatibility is advertised.

THD large datagrams and chunk-boundary splitting are integrated and tested through actual guest imports, including ASan/UBSan-instrumented THD code. Vendor shadNet has different transport and stays unchanged. Relay, protocol/server utility and two-player end-to-end feature comparisons remain pending.

Different engine/Vulkan architecture. Compare native tessellation, shader lifting, YEBIS resource identity and measured costs; FSR 4.1 native is implemented locally but does not certify the remaining renderer utility.
Live CPU-label flush probe and current native-default 120-second route passed. Stage 0 had no outstanding tick: pending GPU step under load, heavy-area real exhaustion and broad soak remain separate.
Broader regions/save slots and long-session acceptance remain separate. Affirmative callback arms exit; title and all savedata unmounts gate shutdown.

Mensis 120-second native 1440p FSR 4.1 capture passes all gates (7200 frames, worst 16.75 ms), hook marker present and screenshot visually inspected. Delayed-GPU and broader visual verification remain pending; default stays off.
Default off; appends synthetic BBHOSTADDON00..02 when enabled and skips any slot already covered by a mounted add-on.
Uses verified retail 1.09 System V registers (rdx in UpdateTransform, edx in HandleChanges) and TreeCacheNode offsets (pRoot +0x18, UpdateFlags +0x44, pNextUpdate +0x48).
